---
title: "9_Brain_vs_Muscle_Comparison"
author: "Noor-Ul-Haya Ahmed"
date: "2026"
output: pdf_document
description: >
  Comparison of skeletal muscle transcriptional signatures against
  CNS transcriptomic datasets from the same diseases.
  CNS datasets: GSE26927 (multi-disease post-mortem CNS covering
  ALS spinal cord, PD substantia nigra, AD entorhinal cortex)
  and GSE122649 (ALS motor cortex RNA-seq).
  Top muscle candidate genes assessed for dysregulation in CNS.
  59 of 60 gene-tissue comparisons classified as muscle-specific.
  Results saved to CNS_Data/.
---

```{r candidate_genes}
# ============================================================
# TOP MUSCLE CANDIDATE GENES TO CHECK IN CNS
# From tiered biomarker framework (Tiers 2-6)
# ============================================================

all_candidates <- c(
  "FOSL1", "TPRG1", "PILRB", "ACSS1", "RFLNA",    # Tier 2
  "SLC40A1", "B3GLCT", "PDE7A",                     # Tier 2
  "MGST3", "RNASEL",                                 # Tier 3
  "TNNC1", "MYH7", "TNNT1", "TNNI1", "MYOZ2",      # Tier 6
  "SOCS3", "KCNN3", "TPM3", "PPP3CC", "PDLIM5"     # Tier 5
)
```

```{r load_gse26927_metadata}
# ============================================================
# GSE26927 — MULTI-DISEASE POST-MORTEM CNS
# Covers: ALS cervical spinal cord, PD substantia nigra,
#         AD entorhinal cortex, HD caudate, MS frontal gyri
# Platform: Illumina HumanRef-8 v2 (GPL6255)
# n per disease: ALS 10 vs 10, PD 12 vs 8, AD 11 vs 7
# ============================================================

gse26927 <- getGEO(
  filename = "CNS_Data/GSE26927_series_matrix.txt",
  getGPL   = FALSE,
  AnnotGPL = FALSE
)
pdata <- pData(gse26927)

# assign group labels from sample title
pdata$Group <- case_when(
  grepl("_Control_", pdata$title) ~ "Control",
  grepl("_Disease_", pdata$title) ~ "Disease",
  TRUE ~ "Unknown"
)
pdata$Disease <- trimws(
  gsub("disease: ", "", pdata$characteristics_ch1)
)

cat("GSE26927 sample breakdown:\n")
print(table(pdata$source_name_ch1, pdata$Group))
```

```{r load_gse26927_expression}
# ============================================================
# LOAD AND NORMALISE GSE26927 EXPRESSION DATA
# Non-normalised Illumina intensities
# Negative values set to 0 (background subtraction artefact)
# Log2(x+1) transform + quantile normalisation
# ============================================================

expr_cns <- read.delim(
  "CNS_Data/GSE26927_non-normalized.txt",
  row.names    = 1,
  check.names  = FALSE
)

cat("Expression matrix dimensions:", dim(expr_cns), "\n")

expr_cns <- as.matrix(expr_cns)
mode(expr_cns) <- "numeric"

# set negative values to 0
cat("Negative values set to 0:",
    sum(expr_cns < 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
expr_cns[expr_cns < 0] <- 0

# log2 transform + quantile normalise
expr_cns_log  <- log2(expr_cns + 1)
expr_cns_log[is.na(expr_cns_log)] <- 0
expr_cns_norm <- normalizeBetweenArrays(
  expr_cns_log, method = "quantile"
)

# remove NA rownames
expr_cns_norm <- expr_cns_norm[
  !is.na(rownames(expr_cns_norm)),
]
expr_cns_norm <- expr_cns_norm[
  rownames(expr_cns_norm) != "",
]
expr_cns_norm[is.na(expr_cns_norm)] <- 0

cat("Normalisation complete\n")
cat("Value range:", range(expr_cns_norm, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Overlap with metadata:",
    sum(colnames(expr_cns_norm) %in% rownames(pdata)), "\n")
```

```{r load_gse26927_annotation}
# ============================================================
# GPL6255 PROBE ANNOTATION
# Illumina HumanRef-8 v2 probe IDs mapped to gene symbols
# Using downloaded GPL6255 SOFT annotation file
# ============================================================

gpl_lines  <- readLines(gzfile("GPL6255_family.soft"))
start_line <- grep("^ID\t", gpl_lines)[1]

gpl_table <- read.delim(
  text = paste(gpl_lines[start_line:(length(gpl_lines) - 1)],
               collapse = "\n"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

probe_to_symbol <- gpl_table %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, SYMBOL) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SYMBOL) & SYMBOL != "") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("Probes with gene symbols:", nrow(probe_to_symbol), "\n")
cat("Coverage of expression matrix:",
    sum(rownames(expr_cns_norm) %in% probe_to_symbol$ID), "\n")
```

```{r gse26927_de_analysis}
# ============================================================
# DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION — GSE26927 CNS SUBSETS
# Three tissue-specific analyses:
#   ALS: cervical spinal cord (n=10 vs 10)
#   PD:  substantia nigra (n=12 vs 8)
#   AD:  entorhinal cortex (n=11 vs 7)
# ============================================================

tissue_comparisons <- list(
  ALS = "Cervical spinal cord",
  PD  = "Substantia nigra",
  AD  = "Entorhinal cortex"
)

cns_de_results <- list()

for(disease in names(tissue_comparisons)){

  tissue <- tissue_comparisons[[disease]]

  cat("\n--- CNS DE:", disease, "-", tissue, "---\n")

  try({

    tissue_meta <- pdata %>%
      filter(source_name_ch1 == tissue,
             Group %in% c("Control", "Disease"))

    cat("Disease:", sum(tissue_meta$Group == "Disease"), "\n")
    cat("Control:", sum(tissue_meta$Group == "Control"), "\n")

    tissue_samples <- rownames(tissue_meta)
    tissue_expr <- expr_cns_norm[,
      colnames(expr_cns_norm) %in% tissue_samples]

    tissue_meta <- tissue_meta[
      match(colnames(tissue_expr), rownames(tissue_meta)),
    ]

    stopifnot(
      identical(colnames(tissue_expr), rownames(tissue_meta))
    )

    group  <- factor(tissue_meta$Group,
                     levels = c("Control", "Disease"))
    design <- model.matrix(~ group)
    fit    <- lmFit(tissue_expr, design)
    fit    <- eBayes(fit)

    res       <- topTable(fit, coef = 2,
                          number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
    res$probe <- rownames(res)

    # map probes to gene symbols
    res <- res %>%
      left_join(probe_to_symbol, by = c("probe" = "ID")) %>%
      dplyr::rename(gene = SYMBOL) %>%
      filter(!is.na(gene) & gene != "") %>%
      group_by(gene) %>%
      slice_min(order_by = adj.P.Val,
                n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup()

    sig <- sum(res$adj.P.Val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    cat("Significant genes:", sig, "\n")

    res$disease <- disease
    res$tissue  <- tissue

    cns_de_results[[disease]] <- res

    write.csv(
      res %>% dplyr::select(gene, logFC, P.Value,
                             adj.P.Val, disease, tissue),
      paste0("CNS_Data/DE_Results/", disease, "_CNS_DE.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    cat("Saved:", disease, "CNS DE\n")
  })
}
```

```{r gse122649_als_motor_cortex}
# ============================================================
# GSE122649 — ALS MOTOR CORTEX RNA-SEQ
# n = 13 ALS vs 6 controls (after averaging technical replicates)
# Processed separately from GSE26927
# ============================================================

cat("\n--- GSE122649 ALS Motor Cortex ---\n")

count_files <- list.files(
  "GSE122649/counts",
  pattern    = "_counts.txt.gz",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Count files found:", length(count_files), "\n")

# read and merge count files
counts_list <- lapply(count_files, function(f){
  df <- read.delim(gzfile(f), header = FALSE,
                   col.names = c("gene", "count"),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df <- df[-1, ]  # remove file path header
  df <- df[!grepl("^__", df$gene), ]  # remove HTSeq rows
  df$count <- as.integer(df$count)
  sample_name <- gsub(".*/(GSM[0-9]+)_.*", "\\1", f)
  result <- data.frame(gene = df$gene, count = df$count,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(result)[2] <- sample_name
  result
})

counts_122649 <- counts_list[[1]][, "gene", drop = FALSE]
for(i in seq_along(counts_list)){
  counts_122649 <- merge(counts_122649, counts_list[[i]],
                          by = "gene", all = TRUE)
}

rownames(counts_122649) <- counts_122649$gene
counts_122649 <- counts_122649[, -1]
counts_122649 <- as.matrix(counts_122649)
mode(counts_122649) <- "integer"

cat("Counts matrix:", dim(counts_122649), "\n")

# build metadata — average technical replicates
files <- list.files("GSE122649/counts",
                     pattern = "_counts.txt.gz")

meta_122649 <- data.frame(
  Sample_ID = gsub("(GSM[0-9]+)_.*", "\\1", files),
  Group     = ifelse(grepl("Co-", files), "Control", "ALS"),
  Patient   = gsub("GSM[0-9]+_(ALS|Co)-([0-9]+)_.*",
                   "\\1\\2", files),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Patient_base = case_when(
      Group == "ALS" ~ paste0("ALS_",
        ceiling(match(Patient,
          unique(Patient[Group == "ALS"])) / 2)),
      Group == "Control" ~ paste0("Co_",
        ceiling(match(Patient,
          unique(Patient[Group == "Control"])) / 2))
    )
  )

# average replicates per patient
patient_ids <- unique(meta_122649$Patient_base)

counts_averaged <- sapply(patient_ids, function(pid){
  samples <- meta_122649$Sample_ID[
    meta_122649$Patient_base == pid]
  if(length(samples) == 1) return(counts_122649[, samples])
  rowMeans(counts_122649[, samples])
})

counts_averaged <- round(counts_averaged)
mode(counts_averaged) <- "integer"

meta_avg <- data.frame(
  Sample_ID = colnames(counts_averaged),
  Group     = ifelse(grepl("^ALS", colnames(counts_averaged)),
                     "ALS", "Control"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("After averaging — ALS:", sum(meta_avg$Group == "ALS"),
    "| Control:", sum(meta_avg$Group == "Control"), "\n")

# DESeq2
keep <- rowSums(counts_averaged >= 10) >= 3
counts_filt <- counts_averaged[keep, ]

dds_122649 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_filt,
  colData   = meta_avg,
  design    = ~ Group
)
dds_122649$Group <- factor(dds_122649$Group,
                            levels = c("Control", "ALS"))
dds_122649 <- DESeq(dds_122649)

res_122649 <- results(
  dds_122649,
  contrast = c("Group", "ALS", "Control"),
  alpha    = 0.05
)

res_df_122649 <- as.data.frame(res_122649)
res_df_122649$gene <- rownames(res_df_122649)

sig <- sum(res_df_122649$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Significant genes (ALS motor cortex):", sig, "\n")

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    gene   = res_df_122649$gene,
    logFC  = res_df_122649$log2FoldChange,
    pvalue = res_df_122649$pvalue,
    padj   = res_df_122649$padj,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  "CNS_Data/DE_Results/ALS_motorcortex_GSE122649_DE.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Saved GSE122649 motor cortex DE results\n")
```

```{r muscle_vs_cns_comparison}
# ============================================================
# MUSCLE VS CNS COMPARISON
# For each candidate gene, check:
#   - Significant in muscle? (padj < 0.05)
#   - Significant in CNS? (padj < 0.05)
#   - Direction concordant?
# 60 gene-tissue comparisons total (20 genes x 3 CNS tissues)
# ============================================================

# load muscle DE results
als_muscle <- read.csv("DE_Results/GSE3307_DE_results.csv",
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
pd_muscle  <- read.csv("DE_Results/GSE140089_DE_results.csv",
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# load CNS DE results
als_cns_26927  <- read.csv(
  "CNS_Data/DE_Results/ALS_CNS_DE.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
pd_cns_26927   <- read.csv(
  "CNS_Data/DE_Results/PD_CNS_DE.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
als_cns_122649 <- read.csv(
  "CNS_Data/DE_Results/ALS_motorcortex_GSE122649_DE.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# build comparison table
comparison_rows <- list()

for(gene in all_candidates){

  als_m  <- als_muscle    %>% filter(gene == !!gene)
  als_c1 <- als_cns_26927 %>% filter(gene == !!gene)
  als_c2 <- als_cns_122649 %>% filter(gene == !!gene)
  pd_m   <- pd_muscle     %>% filter(gene == !!gene)
  pd_c   <- pd_cns_26927  %>% filter(gene == !!gene)

  comparison_rows[[paste("ALS_spinalcord", gene)]] <- data.frame(
    gene          = gene,
    disease       = "ALS",
    cns_source    = "Spinal cord (GSE26927)",
    muscle_sig    = if(nrow(als_m)  > 0)
                      als_m$padj[1]       < 0.05 else FALSE,
    muscle_log2FC = if(nrow(als_m)  > 0)
                      als_m$log2FC[1]     else NA,
    cns_sig       = if(nrow(als_c1) > 0)
                      als_c1$adj.P.Val[1] < 0.05 else FALSE,
    cns_log2FC    = if(nrow(als_c1) > 0)
                      als_c1$logFC[1]     else NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  comparison_rows[[paste("ALS_motorcortex", gene)]] <- data.frame(
    gene          = gene,
    disease       = "ALS",
    cns_source    = "Motor cortex (GSE122649)",
    muscle_sig    = if(nrow(als_m)  > 0)
                      als_m$padj[1]    < 0.05 else FALSE,
    muscle_log2FC = if(nrow(als_m)  > 0)
                      als_m$log2FC[1]  else NA,
    cns_sig       = if(nrow(als_c2) > 0)
                      als_c2$padj[1]   < 0.05 else FALSE,
    cns_log2FC    = if(nrow(als_c2) > 0)
                      als_c2$logFC[1]  else NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  comparison_rows[[paste("PD_substantianigra", gene)]] <- data.frame(
    gene          = gene,
    disease       = "PD",
    cns_source    = "Substantia nigra (GSE26927)",
    muscle_sig    = if(nrow(pd_m) > 0)
                      pd_m$padj[1]      < 0.05 else FALSE,
    muscle_log2FC = if(nrow(pd_m) > 0)
                      pd_m$log2FC[1]    else NA,
    cns_sig       = if(nrow(pd_c) > 0)
                      pd_c$adj.P.Val[1] < 0.05 else FALSE,
    cns_log2FC    = if(nrow(pd_c) > 0)
                      pd_c$logFC[1]     else NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

comparison_table <- bind_rows(comparison_rows) %>%
  mutate(
    muscle_dir = case_when(
      muscle_sig & muscle_log2FC > 0 ~ "Up",
      muscle_sig & muscle_log2FC < 0 ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ),
    cns_dir = case_when(
      cns_sig & cns_log2FC > 0 ~ "Up",
      cns_sig & cns_log2FC < 0 ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ),
    pattern = case_when(
      muscle_sig & cns_sig & muscle_dir == cns_dir ~
        "Shared same direction",
      muscle_sig & cns_sig & muscle_dir != cns_dir ~
        "Shared opposite direction",
      muscle_sig & !cns_sig  ~ "Muscle-specific",
      !muscle_sig & cns_sig  ~ "CNS-specific",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant in either"
    )
  )

cat("\n=== MUSCLE VS CNS PATTERN SUMMARY ===\n")
print(table(comparison_table$cns_source,
            comparison_table$pattern))

cat("\nTotal comparisons:", nrow(comparison_table), "\n")
cat("Muscle-specific:",
    sum(comparison_table$pattern == "Muscle-specific"), "\n")
cat("Shared opposite direction:",
    sum(comparison_table$pattern == "Shared opposite direction"),
    "\n")

write.csv(
  comparison_table,
  "CNS_Data/Muscle_vs_CNS_comparison_final.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nComparison saved to CNS_Data/\n")
```
